fit.weighting: unweighted ordinary least squares in log intensity
fit.uncertainty_scope: Regression standard error only; excludes Dref, temperature, processing and systematic uncertainty

calibration_profile.reference_label: HDO in D2O; local Mills-1973 Arrhenius approximation at mean acquired TE. D2O Ea=18828 J/mol used for trace HDO; reference uncertainty not quantified.
calibration_profile.Dref_uncertainty: not supplied; excluded from reported standard error
calibration_profile.transfer_policy: Same pulse sequence, timings, gradient shape and probe only; not transferable across big Delta or small delta without a verified pulse-sequence model
calibration_profile.status: candidate requiring spectral and residual review; not written to gradpar

temperature.source: acqus TE status; not independent sample thermometry

warnings: Phase/baseline status varies: PHC0, PHC1. Inspect every spectrum before accepting.
DS differs across the ramp. Verify steady-state preparation; amplitudes were not normalized by dummy scans.
Recorded TE varies by 0.77 K. A single supplied Dref is used; no thermal correction was inferred.
Positive signed area and a good fit do not establish peak purity or signal-to-noise. Inspect spectra and residuals.
provenance_policy: All inputs read-only; SHA-256 refers to bytes used for this calculation

bruker_gradient_proposal.identity_check: saved pulseprogram and gpnam6 SHA-256 equal the shared TBO originals
bruker_gradient_proposal.status: derived proposal; spectral/reference review required; not applied to Bruker
bruker_gradient_proposal.uncertainty_scope: regression only; excludes Dref, temperature and pulse-model uncertainty

workshop_offline_replay.status: candidate derived offline from real data; default thermal gate failed; tolerance reassessment example

default_thermal_gate.rejection: TE drift 0.77 K exceeds 0.5 K; stabilize temperature or explicitly reassess tolerance/reference

explicit_review_example.justification: Illustrate the same source data after an explicit offline tolerance change. This is not a scientific acceptance of a 0.77-K drift; reacquiring under stable temperature remains the practical recommendation.

integration_window_choice.method: Read the real first and last spectra. The isolated HDO line is centred at about 4.70536 ppm and is enclosed by a common fixed 4.5–4.9 ppm window. No baseline correction or absolute value added.

reference.approximation: single Dref(Tmean), no pointwise thermal correction inferred by helper
reference.distinction: This new integral result uses Dref at mean TE and is not the historical height-based, gradient-weighted thermal calibration.
